thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-11 has one dated macro item, 'Stock futures rise ahead of August CPI inflation report' -- a mildly positive but purely anticipatory signal ahead of a data release whose outcome is unknown pre-open. That's too thin to act on in either direction. The rest is single-name tech/energy/healthcare commentary and routine politician PTR filings. Existing VTI position (~22.4 of ~107.4 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than trading ahead of an unreleased data print, consistent with capital preservation.
